Products

NEW BRAND is a leading manufacturer specializing in innovative modular container homes and prefabricated building solutions in China. [Company history to be supplied], we have been dedicated to providing high-quality, customizable container homes that combine durability, efficiency, and modern design to meet diverse residential, commercial, and industrial needs.

Custom Solutions for Every Need

Our product line includes: expandable container homes with a double-wing design (available in 10-foot, 20-foot, 30-foot, and 40-foot configurations), foldable container homes engineered for rapid deployment, detachable container homes with modular components for flexibility, cost-effective flat-pack container homes, and modern space capsule houses. We also provide specialized solutions, including construction site containers, container offices, modular medical buildings, modular classrooms, prefabricated bathroom pods, and sandwich panels with insulation and fire resistance.

Get a Free Quote Today

Whether you require residential housing, industrial warehouses, disaster relief shelters, or temporary housing, our modular container homes can be fully customized to your specific requirements. We provide comprehensive services in design, manufacturing, transportation, installation guidance, and after-sales support. Contact our team today for a free consultation to discover how NEW BRAND can deliver the perfect prefabricated container solution for your project.

Construction Worker Dormitory Container
Construction worker dormitory containers provide engineered, prefabricated housing solutions for large-scale construction projects requiring temporary worker accommodations. These ISO-compliant modular housing units enable rapid deployment, cost reduction, and flexible configurations for construction sites worldwide.

These site container dormitories are designed for scalability and can be stacked up to three stories high or arranged horizontally to create complete construction camps. These modular camps include worker dormitories, on-site offices, dining facilities, and restrooms, requiring minimal site preparation.
Military Container Barracks
Military container barracks are rapidly deployable, modular structures constructed from weather-resistant steel containers, providing durable and flexible housing and living facilities (such as kitchens, bathrooms, and medical stations) for field forces.

These military container barracks can be configured to serve various purposes, including field barracks, command centers, and medical facilities. Designed for rapid assembly and disassembly, these prefabricated military barracks support modern military logistics in diverse and challenging environments.
Modular Medical Clinic
NEW BRAND's Modular Medical Clinic represents a breakthrough in portable medical infrastructure. Our prefab medical facilities provide fully functional clinical spaces that can be rapidly deployed in a variety of medical settings. Combining durability and functionality, our modular medical clinics provide immediate medical services to communities or remote areas. Ideal applications include:

- Rural and remote community healthcare

- Emergency medical relief facilities

- Temporary hospital expansions

- Vaccination and screening centers

- Mobile medical clinics

- Disaster relief medical stations

- Construction site medical facilities

- Field hospitals

- Community health outreach projects
Prefab Portable Double Toilet Block
Prefab portable double toilet units are factory-prefabricated, freestanding toilet units that typically combine two toilets or squat toilets into one unit. Prefabricated double toilets use a durable steel frame and integrated plumbing, wiring, and ventilation systems. They offer fast installation and convenience for construction sites, event venues, or remote areas.

Portable double toilet units reduce installation time and labor compared to traditional construction methods. These modular toilet units are cost-effective, easy to transport, and serve as an excellent alternative to permanent restrooms. They can be configured for separate male and female use, or as unisex facilities, and can be easily relocated as needed.
Prefab Self-Contained Toilet Unit
This Prefab Self-Contained Toilet Unit is designed to provide a comfortable and hygienic environment for various settings. It is a factory-prefabricated and ready-to-install modular bathroom unit. Prefab self-contained bathrooms offer a cost-effective and convenient solution for projects that require rapid installation and easy maintenance. Unlike standard toilets, which require a permanent connection to sewage pipes and water mains, self-contained bathroom units typically incorporate their own wastewater storage and water supply systems.
Modular Classroom Building
NEW BRAND's modular classroom buildings are prefabricated educational facilities manufactured in a controlled factory environment and assembled on-site. They provide flexible learning space for school expansions, training centers, temporary campuses, and other education-related projects.

With factory-prefabricated components and efficient on-site assembly, NEW BRAND can customize classroom layouts, structural configurations, insulated wall systems, doors, windows, and interior options to suit project requirements.
Mobile Medical Container
Mobile medical containers function as portable medical centers, ready to deliver emergency healthcare wherever needed. Designed by NEW BRAND, these specialized mobile container medical facilities can store and transport medical supplies, equipment, and even entire medical facilities, enabling rapid response to emergencies and disasters. From disaster relief to medical missions in remote areas, mobile medical containers play a vital role in providing healthcare to those in need.
Handmade Gypsum Rockwool Sandwich Panel
Handmade gypsum rock wool sandwich panels are a composite material featuring rock wool as a high-density core filler and smooth gypsum boards on both surfaces. Reinforced with an aluminum alloy or galvanized steel frame, these high-performance sandwich panels are manufactured through a manual composite process.

Gypsum rock wool sandwich panels offer outstanding fire resistance, thermal insulation, sound absorption, and moisture resistance. They are widely used in partition and ceiling systems for cleanrooms, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, and high-standard industrial spaces.
Metal Outdoor Storage Shed
This Metal Outdoor Storage Shed from NEW BRAND combines durability and practicality to help you easily solve your home's outdoor storage problems. These metal storage sheds are commonly used in residential, commercial, and industrial areas for storing tools, equipment, vehicles, and other items. Metal storage sheds come in a wide variety of sizes and designs, from simple, small outdoor storage sheds to large workshops and garages.
Containerized Substation Facility
Containerized substation facilities are pre-assembled mobile substations installed within standard containers, making them a portable, cost-effective, and rapid power distribution solution. These prefabricated units allow for quick installation with minimal on-site work, making them ideal for temporary, remote, or space-constrained applications. They can be utilized for renewable energy grid connection, mining, data center, or municipal grid support, providing flexible, cost-effective, and weather-independent power distribution.
Container Car Workshop for Sale
A container car workshop is a workshop built from a repurposed container, offering a durable, cost-effective, and customizable workspace. These workshops can be used for various hobbies, personal or business, with customization options including insulation, electrical setups, workbenches, windows, and ventilation. Container car workshops are a sustainable and practical alternative to traditional sheds or garages.
Double-wide Container Garage
Need a garage big enough for two vehicles, a full workshop, or safe storage? A double-wide container garage with roll-up doors gives you all that and costs less than a traditional brick-and-mortar build.

At NEW BRAND, our double-wide garage is constructed from two high-grade Corten steel containers placed side by side, with the shared interior wall removed to create one open, drive-in space. The result is a weather-tight, low-maintenance structure that goes up in days, not months.
